name: Deep research: BRCA1 DNA repair survey with ledger-rendered citations
title_en: Deep research — BRCA1 DNA repair literature survey (English)
title_zh: 深度研究——BRCA1 DNA 修复文献调研（英文）
summary_en: The bioresearcher-deep-research skill's interview-free light path decomposes a topic, dispatches parallel workers that append every citable source to a per-aspect evidence ledger, synthesizes a cite-key draft, then the ledger script renders the numbered citations + References (single numbering authority) and vet-references.py audits them - producing reports/<topic>/final_report.md and, by default, final_report.html.
summary_zh: bioresearcher-deep-research 技能的免访谈轻量路径：分解主题、并行派发工作节点（把每条可引用来源追加到逐方面证据账本）、以引用键草稿汇总，再由账本脚本统一编号渲染引用与参考文献（唯一编号权威）并经 vet-references.py 审计——产出 reports/<topic>/final_report.md 及默认开启的 final_report.html。
purpose: Flagship agent demo: deep-research skill + keyless biomcp MCP server; evidence-ledger citation pipeline (worker ledgers -> merge/verify -> render -> vet) with default-on HTML rendering.
prompt: no-interview light-research: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, survey the recent article landscape on BRCA1 DNA repair. Keep it to at most 2 research aspects and at most 10 biomcp tool calls per aspect worker. Cite sources with PMIDs.

checks.desc: parallel worker dispatch (Tier A/B) is mandatory when a subagent tool exists (deep-research 1.7.0 Step 4)
tier-independent literature proof: ledger keys (add echo / check stdout) contain line-start pmid: entries - live dispatch runs keep article_search inside worker streams, invisible to the parent log
render verb success banner: the numbering authority generated the citations + References section (FAILED banners must not match)
the Step 5c offline structural audit passed: contiguous [1]..[N], N == bibliography count, zero placeholders
HTML rendering is default-on; a successful conversion rung must surface final_report.html in tool output

checks.flag: verify-citation-pipeline-artifacts (inspect reports/<TOPIC>/final_report.draft.md, final_report.md and evidence/sources.jsonl): (a) the draft still contains [@key] cite-key markers - proof it was authored key-based, never hand-numbered; (b) the References section is ledger-generated Vancouver style (consistent author initials, journal, year, PMID/DOI per entry); (c) in-text citations are contiguous [1]..[N] numbered by order of first appearance.
